facts.fact: Austria-based OeSD International GmbH is to finance about US$54.7 million of nationwide ID enrolment and infrastructure in Liberia under a Build, Operate and Transfer concession with the Government that NIR says is signed but awaits legislative ratification; as_of is the 2026-09-08 publication date, as no signing date is given.
